articleBody:
A broken pipe, whether it's a slow leak or a full-blown gush, can throw a wrench in your day. Knowing how to react and what to prepare can make a huge difference in limiting damage and getting your Las Vegas property back to normal. This checklist helps you manage the situation and prepare for professional help effectively.

- [ ] Locate and shut off your main water valve — why this immediately stops further water flow and damage to your property.
- [ ] Turn off the water supply to the specific fixture if possible — why isolating the break minimizes water loss while you assess the situation.
- [ ] Open nearby faucets to drain remaining water from the pipes — why this relieves pressure and helps clear the lines for inspection.
- [ ] Identify the general location and type of break (e.g., supply line, drainpipe) — why this information helps the plumber diagnose and prepare for the repair more quickly.
- [ ] Clear the area around the broken pipe for accessibility — why providing clear access allows technicians to work efficiently and safely.
- [ ] Take photos or videos of the damage before cleanup — why this documentation is essential for any potential insurance claims.
- [ ] Note any associated issues like reduced water pressure or soggy spots — why these details can offer clues to the cause and extent of the problem.

How to use this checklist:
Go through these items methodically as soon as you discover a broken pipe. This helps you gather critical information, mitigate immediate damage, and be ready to provide a licensed plumber, like those at CG Plumbing Solutions, with everything they need for a swift and effective repair. Don't skip steps, especially shutting off the water, to protect your property.
